comments.text:
The mountain got me through the hardest part of my life, just got out of the navy, my ex-wife and I separated, I was disowned by my family, left homeless, nearly murdered by girlfriend and her side-pieces because she couldn’t take no for an answer, left with a cracked skull, broken eye socket, slashed sclera in the other eye, a jaw broken in 2 places, 3 broken ribs, damaged liver and spleen. Left for dead trying to recover and heal in a broken car, Only to be stabbed in the chest with a screwdriver by a fucking lot lizard and her drugged out pimp. Fuck Ohio, scrounged up some money after finally getting a job, only to leave the state for Texas, the first day I got to my friends house, my car then got impounded( I didn’t pay attention to the parking lot signs), got kicked out because I was fired from my job because I couldnt arrive on time because I had to walk to work. Nearly died yet again due to starvation, I had my sea bag stolen from me while going to the restroom at a Walmart. It had all I had left in there: paperwork, documents my clothes, wallet, and my only source of peace, my Nintendo switch. I survived off of free drinks from McDonalds, and a found phone I found a way of hacking and resetting to call my sister for help. She sent dad to find me; he saved my life, got me set up with new documents, reset my id and social security card. Got a job at Amazon, and met my current wife who I’ve now been with for 5 years. We now have our own apartment, and I’m now a IC lead for a logistics company. 

Life’s fucking wild. But it’s thanks to this song that I survived and got through it all!
comments.author: @brocafseth1736
